explicit_limits: This profile is ISO C++20 plus a fixture-owned Make build; it does not imply C, Objective-C, Objective-C++, CUDA, CMake, Xcode, Bazel, Meson, modules, frameworks, or alternate standard-library support.

The JSON profile owns .cc, .cpp, .cxx, .c++, .ii, and unambiguous C++ declaration/template suffixes. Case-sensitive .C is owned only by the C++ provider because the shared profile schema intentionally accepts lowercase suffixes; it must never be lowercased into C. Module suffixes .cppm, .ixx, and .mpp remain unsupported.
A .h or .inc file is C++ only when a trustworthy C++ compile command and its dependency closure own it; otherwise it remains ambiguous. Suffixes .c, .i, .m, and .mm are never C++ claims.

Makefile presence proves a build marker, not semantic readiness. Cross-translation-unit facts require a valid, current, complete compile_commands.json whose effective commands use C++20 mode; missing, malformed, stale, incomplete, wrong-language, wrong-mode, or fallback commands cannot produce a complete semantic outcome.

Clang AST JSON and raw-token output are version-gated feasibility inputs, not stable cross-version APIs or skill final outcomes. Templates, overloads, ADL, implicit operations, ODR, exceptions/RTTI, ABI/layout, target/sysroot/defines/include order, conditional compilation, generated headers, and non-default variants remain explicit limits.
